requirements.missing: No document specifies a chickpea first-irrigation trigger (soil-moisture threshold, pre-/post-emergence growth-stage cue, or calendar window). s0/s3 note chickpea is 'somewhat drought tolerant' and that 'too frequent' irrigation increases disease, but give no decision rule for the first event.

No source provides chickpea-specific measured inputs for first irrigation: volumetric water content, tension, depletion percentage, monitored depth, growth stage at recommendation, geography, or volume/timing interval. s0/s3 state chickpea 'uses water mostly from the top 12 inches of soil,' and s4/s5 give AWC/MAD tables for other crops only — chickpea is absent from those tables.

While Cicer arietinum is confirmed in s0/s1/s2/s3, none link the crop identity to an early-season/root-establishment irrigation recommendation; the irrigation-relevant text (s0/s3) discusses seasonal totals and disease risk from over-irrigation, not first-water decision criteria. s5 (chickpea-specific irrigation thresholds) is absent — its MAD table covers alfalfa, cantaloupe, corn, soybean, etc., but not chickpea.
